acceptance_before_promotion: Official eval completes under the harness.
Zero off-limit contacts on all trials.
Improves over the promoted score baseline by at least +1.0, or earns insertion/contact evidence that justifies further Gate 2 iteration.
If rejected, append ledger and keep gate_2 in progress.
candidate_rationale: The lateral signs are consistent across the two SFP failures: move negative x and positive y in the base command frame.
A 0.75s command at -0.01,+0.02 m/s covers about -7.5mm,+15mm before controller/contact effects, matching trial 2 and exceeding trial 1 only moderately.
The axial component is reduced from -0.02 to -0.012 m/s to avoid jamming while lateral alignment changes.
The existing SC 2.75s stop remains unchanged because SC was already made safe by stopping before the enclosure contact.
finding: The delta force guard allowed final-servo motion, but SFP failures are dominated by lateral offset at/near the entrance, not lack of axial advance alone.

sfp_trials.interpretation: Tip reached the entrance plane but did not enter; axial push accumulated TCP reference error while the plug tip stayed laterally offset.
Axial depth improved, but the tip remained about 1.6 cm laterally from the port centerline.
